name: E-Tranzact
source: eTranzact International Plc statement of profit or loss for the second quarter ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), six months column, thousands scaled to naira. The filing prints no earnings per share line in its statement, so the row is left blank for this period. Net finance costs are finance cost less investment income, stored negative for a net income. | eTRANZACT International Plc Annual Report 2025, Report of the Directors operating results p.4 (N thousands): revenue 30,610,184 and 29,896,490, gross profit 14,311,201 and 11,359,158, operating profit 3,951,745 and 4,661,951, profit before income tax 4,199,136 and 4,897,062, income tax 1,729,469 and 1,503,730, profit after tax 2,469,667 and 3,393,332, basic and diluted earnings per share 27 and 37 kobo. The stored FY2024 figure was the year itself

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: EPS

unitGuard.reason: unit guard: the EPS row for FY2023 read 0.000239324 against 0.239325 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 0.001, which is the 1000x reciprocal of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.239324, the unit the price is quoted in.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
rows.formula: Net Profit / weighted average shares implied by the company's own reported EPS

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.derivedCellFormula: Profit Before Tax = Net Profit + Income Tax

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding

unitNormalised.basis: market-cap anchored: cap 1.012e+11, net profit 3.39333e+06, revenue 3.06102e+07; at x1000 P/E 29.82, P/S 3.306

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024, FY2021; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note).
